speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The clinical presentation of respiratory acidosis, hypoxemia, and the chest X-ray findings of a ground-glass appearance with air bronchograms are classic for RDS, likely due to surfactant deficiency in a preterm infant.
